text_en: The one who keeps the law makes many offerings;
text_cn: 遵守法律，便等于献的祭献多；

text_en: one who heeds the commandments makes an offering of well-being.
text_cn: 坚守诫命，远离一切邪恶，便是奉献和平祭。

text_en: The one who returns a kindness offers choice flour,
text_cn: 远离邪恶，就是举行赎罪祭，和为所犯的罪求赦的祈祷。

text_en: and one who gives alms sacrifices a thank offering.
text_cn: 感恩等于奉献上等面粉，施舍等于赞美祭。

text_en: To keep from wickedness is pleasing to the Lord, and to forsake unrighteousness is an atonement.
text_cn: 远离邪恶，就是悦乐上主；逃避不义，便是赎罪祭。

text_en: Do not appear before the Lord empty-handed,
text_cn: 不要空手到上主面前去；

text_en: for all that you offer is in fulfillment of the commandment.
text_cn: 因为这一切，为了天主的诫命，都应当执行。

text_en: The offering of the righteous enriches the altar, and its pleasing odor rises before the Most High.
text_cn: 义人的献仪，使祭坛丰盈；它的馨香上升到至高者面前。

text_en: The sacrifice of the righteous is acceptable, and it will never be forgotten.
text_cn: 义人的祭品，必蒙悦纳；上主常记得它，决不会忘记。

text_en: Be generous when you worship the Lord, and do not stint the first fruits of your hands.
text_cn: 你光荣上主要爽快，不要吝惜你手中所献的初熟之果。

text_en: With every gift show a cheerful face, and dedicate your tithe with gladness.
text_cn: 在一切祭献上，要喜形于色；奉献什一之物时，也要高兴。

text_en: Give to the Most High as he has given to you, and as generously as you can afford.
text_cn: 按照至高者所赐给你的，奉献给他；依照你手中所得的，慷慨奉献给他；

text_en: For the Lord is the one who repays, and he will repay you sevenfold.
text_cn: 因为报答世人的上主，必要七倍地报答你。

text_en: Do not offer him a bribe, for he will not accept it;
text_cn: 你不要行贿赂，因为他决不会接受的；

text_en: and do not rely on a dishonest sacrifice; for the Lord is the judge, and with him there is no partiality.
text_cn: 你不要依靠不义的祭品，因为上主是审判者，决不看情面。

text_en: He will not show partiality to the poor; but he will listen to the prayer of one who is wronged.
text_cn: 他决不偏袒任何人，而加害穷人；他倒乐于俯听受压迫者的祈祷；

text_en: He will not ignore the supplication of the orphan, or the widow when she pours out her complaint.
text_cn: 他决不轻视孤儿的哀求，和寡妇诉苦的叹息。

text_en: Do not the tears of the widow run down her cheek
text_cn: 寡妇的泪，岂不是沿颊流下来？她的哀号，岂不是控告那使她流泪的人？

text_en: as she cries out against the one who causes them to fall?
text_cn: 她的眼泪，从面颊上达于天，俯听的上主见了，非常不满。

text_en: The one whose service is pleasing to the Lord will be accepted, and his prayer will reach to the clouds.
text_cn: 凡诚心诚意恭敬天主的，必蒙接纳；他的祈祷上彻云霄。

text_en: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds, and it will not rest until it reaches its goal; it will not desist until the Most High responds
text_cn: 谦卑人的祈祷，穿云而上，不达到目的，决不甘休；不等至高者见了，为义人伸冤，执行正义，决不离开。

text_en: and does justice for the righteous, and executes judgment. Indeed, the Lord will not delay, and like a warrior will not be patient until he crushes the loins of the unmerciful
text_cn: 上主决不迟延，至刚毅者决不再容忍他们，必要粉碎残忍人的腰背，

text_en: and repays vengeance on the nations; until he destroys the multitude of the insolent, and breaks the scepters of the unrighteous;
text_cn: 必对异邦人实行报复；直到他将强横的群众铲除，将不义者的权杖折断；

text_en: until he repays mortals according to their deeds, and the works of all according to their thoughts;
text_cn: 直到他按照每人的行为还报他们，依照人们的图谋，报答他们的工作；

text_en: until he judges the case of his people and makes them rejoice in his mercy.
text_cn: 直到他裁判自己百姓的案件，使他们因自己的仁慈得到喜悦。

text_en: His mercy is as welcome in time of distress as clouds of rain in time of drought.
text_cn: 在患难时，天主的仁慈是甘饴的，有如大旱时的云雨。
